settings.intro: I'm a Software Engineer at VLogic Innovations with 3+ years building production web software end to end: Angular front-ends, ASP.NET APIs and SQL Server. On my own time I build open-source tools like GistVault and experiment with ML services like FaceMatch Pro.
settings.availabilityText: Open to full-stack & frontend roles · Kerala, India · Remote-friendly
settings.about: I'm from Kollam, Kerala. I like taking a messy workflow and turning it into a fast, typed, tested app — and I care about the details users notice: spacing, keyboard support, load time. Photography and video editing keep that eye sharp.
settings.learningNote: Completed GitHub Skills tracks in 2026 and merged open-source pull requests.

highlights: Built-in secret scanner blocks API keys and tokens before they reach a gist.

projects.title: GistVault
projects.summary: Save the shell commands you look up twice — in a secret gist on your own GitHub account. No server, no database: the browser talks to GitHub directly.

projects.title: FaceMatch Pro

projects.seoDescription: FaceMatch Pro: face recognition with an Angular 21 UI, an ASP.NET Core (.NET 10) API and a Python FastAPI service using InsightFace embeddings.
